syllabus_topics: Means for realization of control loop in general, division of the means based on transfer of information, signals and construction, comparing of various systems{priorities of pneumatic, hydraulic and electric system}
Static and dynamic qualities of the control means, possibilities of their evaluation with regards to the measured response
Function of the amplifier as a basic construction element of pneumatic and hydraulic means of control, hydraulic servomotor
Pneumatic drivers {function of corrector}, valves, the notation for drawing diagrams for control loops by norm
Labour, control and auxiliary means to control single and double actuating pneumatic cylinders
Possibilities of control more actuating pneumatic cylinders - application of quickstepper and relay mode of control
Signal filtering, analogue filters
Digital filtering, Finite Impulse Response filteres (FIR), Infinite response filters (IIR).
Analogue controllers and their realisation. Input and output signals
Discrete PID controllers, algorithm, alliasing, wind-up effect, experimental methods of settings
Electrical actuators, AC, DC, stepper motors, electromagnets. Dynamical properties, model of DC motor.
Busses, serial communications. Interface TIA/EIA 232F,422B, 485A. Current loop
Industrial communication systems, Reference model ISO/OSI. Profibus, CAN, -Net. AS-interface, HART.
Application of Matlab for simulation of dynamic and static properties of control means (dynamic error, frequency limit and etc.) - laboratory PC
Simulation of the amplifier supply with the feedback, dynamic properties of the hydraulic servomotor - laboratory PC
Practical acquaintance with pneumatic motors, controllable and auxiliary means for realization of control- laboratory FESTO
Practical application - laboratory FESTO
Control of single and double actuating pneumatic cylinders (laboratory FESTO)
Filters - amplitude and phase curve - measurement
Filter + PID controller, Matlab simulation
PID controllers, practical settings
PID controllers, practical settings
DC motor, static and dynamic parameters identification
AC induction motor and frequency converter
Electrical servomotor and controller for positioning
Stepper motor
